title: Sparse integer routing without a prefix shortcut
body: The inherited model has 8192 deterministic hashed features spanning first-token, token, positioned-token, and byte n-gram counts. In this task the first-token feature is constant across five exactly balanced classes, so it carries no class information. Balanced distractor classes also prevent a wrong-operation cue from winning by frequency alone. Success therefore requires later lexical or compositional evidence that transfers across 30 training and 20 surface-disjoint promotion template families.
claims: The feature map, class order, all-zero initialization, update rule, and four-epoch budget are unchanged from the prior Solomon Q22 class-head lineage.
The prefix-only baseline is exactly 200000 ppm and cannot satisfy any preregistered performance gate.
